metadataRaw.title: How to Fix Bad Back Posture | STEP-BY-STEP Guide
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how to quickly improve bad back posture.

A common cause of poor posture is because of a tight chest muscles that draw us forward (think using a cell phone) and weakness in the back muscles. This may lead to a rounded back and shoulders.

To fix this, we're going to break the video up into an easy step-by-step guide to help lengthen and strengthen these muscles.

All of the exercises can be done at home, require no equipment, and may give fast results... even within 30 seconds.

Watch now and fix bad back posture for good!

Chapters:
0:00 Intro
1:01 Muscle Warm Up
4:05 Strengthening Exercise 1
6:16 Strengthening Exercise 2 
8:55 Stretching Exercise 1
10:38 Stretching Exercise 2
